from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
root=Path('src/climate')
files=[p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.cpp','.h','.hpp','.c'}]
print('=== STRUCTURE SUMMARY ===')
print('SOURCE_FILES',len(files))
bydir=Counter(str(p.parent) for p in files)
for d,n in sorted(bydir.items(), key=lambda x:(x[0].count('/'),x[0])):
    print(f'DIR|{d}|files={n}')
print('=== TOP-LEVEL FILES ===')
for p in sorted([p for p in files if p.parent==root]):
    print(p)
print('TOP_LEVEL_COUNT',sum(p.parent==root for p in files))
print('=== LARGEST FILES BY LINES ===')
rows=[]
for p in files:
    try: n=sum(1 for _ in p.open(errors='ignore'))
    except OSError: continue
    rows.append((n,str(p)))
for n,p in sorted(rows, reverse=True)[:40]: print(f'{n:5d} {p}')
print('=== DUPLICATE BASENAMES ===')
base=defaultdict(list)
for p in files: base[p.name].append(str(p))
for name,ps in sorted(base.items()):
    if len(ps)>1: print(name,'|',' | '.join(ps))
PY
